scope: Central versus completed offline plain-FedAvg trainer; operational online learner schedule is not used by this offline training script.

same.features: same validated float32 X169, no new normalization
same.masks: same boolean M9 and -1e9 invalid logits in identical compiled_step
same.initialization: build_routing_policy_model seed42 deterministic common weights; reconstruction only, no update
same.loss: identical mean masked sparse categorical crossentropy fromlogits
same.dtype: float32 training, float64 analytical probability summation

intentional_differences.central: one chronological epoch; continuous Adam state; ceil(2656632/32)=83020 optimizersteps
intentional_differences.fedavg: five rounds; eachclient receives common global weights; Adam variables explicitly reset to fresh initial state for everyclient/round; one chronological localepoch; ceil(client_N/32) steps; final partialbatch used
intentional_differences.order: central chronological allclients; clientexamples stable chronological withinclient; no shuffling
intentional_differences.small_clients: positivecount participates including finalpartialbatch; zeros excluded; no local subsampling
intentional_differences.aggregation: samplecount-weighted final weights; all tensors previously independently verified; weighting is by observations not optimizersteps

limitation: No rerun training. No accidental inconsistency found; intentional optimizer reset/local ordering can cause statistical optimization drift.
